title: Application for consent to change a company's name
ruleSource: Written from S.A Badmus' Corporate Law drafts (Lawdeck knowledge base). To be confirmed by the legal reviewer, including every section of the Companies and Allied Matters Act 2020 cited.

parts.why: The letterhead: the sender's name, address and contacts at the top. Source: Corporate Law Practice drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

References come before the date; leave them blank if none was given. Letters are dated; notices and resolutions carry their date at the end. Source: Corporate Law Practice drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).
The addressee's name or office and address, before the salutation. Source: Corporate Law Practice drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).
The salutation. Source: Corporate Law Practice drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

parts.text: APPLICATION FOR CONSENT TO CHANGE THE NAME OF {{oldName}} PURSUANT TO SECTION 50(1) OF THE COMPANIES AND ALLIED MATTERS ACT 2020
parts.why: The subject, with the law relied on. Source: Corporate Law Practice drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

parts.text:
I am directed by the Board of Directors of the above company to apply for the approval of the Commission for the name of the company to be changed from {{oldName}} to {{newName}}.

Please find enclosed the documents necessary to effect the change, including a special resolution duly passed on {{resolutionDate}} authorising the change.

The circumstances that make the change of name desirable are: {{reasons}}.

Thank you.
parts.why: States the authority (the board), the old and new names, the special resolution and the reasons for the change. Source: Corporate Law Practice drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

The complimentary close, the signature space, and the name and capacity of the person signing. Always sign a draft in the exam. Source: Corporate Law Practice drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

parts.text:
Enclosed:
#. Special resolution dated {{resolutionDate}}
#. Original certificate of incorporation of the company, for cancellation
#. Updated annual returns
#. Memorandum and articles of association as altered to reflect the new name, duly signed
#. Evidence of payment of the prescribed fees
parts.why: The enclosures the Commission requires. Source: Corporate Law Practice drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

fields.label: Sender
fields.question: Who is the letter from? The law firm, company or person, as it appears on the letterhead.

fields.label: Sender's address and contacts
fields.question: The sender's address, email and phone number for the letterhead.

fields.label: Date of the letter
fields.question: What date should the letter bear? Use a date close to the facts, never after the exam date.

fields.label: Addressee
fields.question: Who is the letter to? Give the name or office, for example The Divisional Police Officer.

fields.label: Capacity of the person signing
fields.question: In what capacity do they sign? For example: Principal Partner, Company Secretary.

fields.label: Present name
fields.question: What is the company's present name?

fields.label: Proposed name
fields.question: What is the proposed new name?

fields.label: Date of the special resolution
fields.question: When was the special resolution passed?
